scripts.build: npm run build:tailwind && npm run sync:html-assets
scripts.deploy:ready: node --test test/server.test.js && npm run build:static && echo 'Deploy ./dist as your publish directory (or html if your host is configured that way).'
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build:static && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name jennibwebsite --branch main
scripts.cf:deploy:preview: npm run build:static && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name jennibwebsite --branch preview
